name: AmNet
summary: Perth ISP/IT group (Amnet Limited: Amnet Internet Services, Amnet IT Services, Amnet IX, Ezsoftwrite); acquired by Amcom 1 Oct 2003, later a Vocus brand via the 2015 Amcom merger; the Amnet Broadband domain remains live (AMNET BROADBAND PTY LTD, ACN 092 472 350).

events.details: Amcom Telecommunications acquired the Amnet group (A$2.14M); independent Amnet ends here. Not acquired by iiNet.

amnet.com.au served an Amcom-branded 'Amnet BroadBand' Perth ADSL site into early 2009, then began returning 301 redirects from Mar 2009; the domain and brand later passed to Vocus (2015 Amcom merger) and amnet.com.au remains a live Vocus retail brand in 2026.
